title: fix: simplify model ID announcement
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Introduces the September 7 model ID change without assuming a previous announcement.
- Replaces “canonical” and “publisher-qualified” jargon with one example and a clear compatibility statement.
- Keeps the updated rollout date, current styling, and complete model ID mapping link.

Follow-up to #13587 and #14081.

Test: `npm run typecheck` in `enter.pollinations.ai`

gist.headline: Model names, less pollen
gist.blurb: The September 7 model ID notice got a small pruning. One clear example, a compatibility note, and the full mapping link now do the talking.
gist.summary: Clarified the September 7 model ID rollout across the README, model list, and news banner with a concrete ID example, a compatibility statement, and a link to the complete model mapping.
gist.impact: Developers can more quickly understand which model IDs to use after September 7 and confirm that existing compatible IDs continue to work.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tidying a garden of neatly labeled model-ID seed packets beside a cozy retro terminal, with an old confusing sign replaced by one simple example and a map. The scene represents clearer naming and a compatibility path rather than a new model; use a small model-mapping scroll, code-plants, and a few flowers.
